items.title: AIChipBench: Benchmarking LLM Agents for Automated AI Accelerator Design
items.author: Guangyuan Wang, Chengran Li, Minchen Luo, Jichen Feng, Mengdi Wang, Yifan Zhang
items.snippet: A language-model decoder carries state between decoding steps, and in hardware a wrong state update can leave the current token correct and corrupt the output several tokens later, so a design can pass output tests and still be wrong. AIChipBench asks what LLM coding agents…
